name: SynchroHRM
description:
SynchroHRM night-audit reports and NetSuite postings, through its read-only SQL endpoint (`POST /api/device/sql`). Only the fixed queries below are ever sent; Erynne and Claude fill in the property, date and counts.

**Setup**

1. In SynchroHRM, Settings → Device Access Tokens: issue a token named *Mnemerynne* with **Can read: Read-only SQL queries**, and paste it as the credential here (Bearer).
2. Press **Fetch from server** and compare the fingerprint with the one on the SynchroHRM host (`openssl s_client -connect localhost:443 </dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256`). Save only if they match. If calls then fail on the certificate name, untick *Check the name in the certificate*.
3. Set the AD group (accounting or ops), then press **Test** on each operation.

**Claude:** these operations return only statistics and posting status. Don't add operations that read the parsed report tables (e.g. `opera_in_house_guest_rows`, `opera_arrival_rows`) while Claude's switch is on: they hold guest names.

operations.name: Latest reports per property
operations.description: For each hotel: the latest business date with parsed night-audit reports, and how many report files it has.

body.sql: SELECT property_slug, max(report_date) AS latest_business_date, count(*) AS files FROM attachments WHERE status = 'parsed' AND superseded_by_attachment_id IS NULL GROUP BY property_slug ORDER BY latest_business_date

example_questions: Did every hotel send its reports?
Which hotel is behind on night audit?
What's the latest night audit date for each property?
Are any hotels missing their night audit reports?

operations.name: Parse failures
operations.description: Night-audit report files that failed to parse in the last few days: when, which hotel, the file and the error.

body.sql: SELECT received_at, property_slug, attachment_name, parse_error FROM attachments WHERE status = 'failed' AND received_at >= datetime('now', ?) ORDER BY received_at DESC

example_questions: Did any night audit reports fail to parse?
Which report files failed this week?
Are there any parse errors in SynchroHRM?
Why didn't a hotel's report import?

operations.name: Day's statistics vs NetSuite
operations.description: One hotel's statistics for one business date (account, value, unit) with the NetSuite posting status, transaction ID and any error.

body.sql: SELECT a.account_number, a.value, a.unit, p.status, p.netsuite_tran_id, p.error_message FROM analytics_daily_values a LEFT JOIN netsuite_sdu_posting_attempts p ON p.property_slug = a.property_slug AND p.report_date = a.business_date WHERE a.property_slug = ? AND a.business_date = ?

example_questions: What were the Pendleton Best Western's stats yesterday?
Did Home2 Salem's numbers post to NetSuite for October 21?
Show the daily statistics for the Kennewick Best Western.
What did the Holiday Inn Express Ellensburg post to NetSuite yesterday?

operations.name: Unresolved NetSuite failures
operations.description: NetSuite postings that failed and haven't since gone through: hotel, report date, posting unit, error and when it was tried.

body.sql: SELECT f.property_slug, f.report_date, f.posting_unit, f.error_message, f.finished_at FROM netsuite_sdu_posting_attempts f WHERE f.status = 'failed' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM netsuite_sdu_posting_attempts s WHERE s.external_id = f.external_id AND s.status IN ('submitted', 'already_exists')) ORDER BY f.finished_at DESC

example_questions: Are there any NetSuite posting failures?
Which hotels failed to post to NetSuite?
What's stuck in NetSuite?
Did any statistics fail to post?

operations.name: Recent mailbox polls
operations.description: SynchroHRM's latest mailbox polls: when, status, messages seen, attachments parsed and failed, and notes.
operations.body: {"sql": "SELECT started_at, status, messages_seen, attachments_parsed, attachments_failed, notes FROM ingest_runs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ?", "params": [{{count}}], "maxRows": 50}
example_questions: Is SynchroHRM picking up the night audit emails?
When did SynchroHRM last check the mailbox?
Show the recent mailbox polls.
Is the report mailbox import working?
